categories.main_business_segments: YSB Inc. operates primarily in the outside-of-hospital pharmaceutical industry in China, focusing on two main business segments: the Online Marketplace, which connects pharmaceutical distributors and vendors with pharmacies and primary healthcare institutions, and the Self-operation Business, which sells selected pharmaceutical and healthcare products directly to downstream users through proprietary fulfillment systems. Additionally, the company offers ancillary services including SaaS solutions for inventory and clinic management, medical testing services, and pharmacist training through YSB eLearn.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital technologies including AI, big data analytics, and smart supply chain management systems to optimize procurement, warehousing, logistics, and marketing. It integrates hardware and software solutions such as point-of-care testing devices (FutureClou series), AI doctor-aid systems (ClouWiseDoctor), and SaaS platforms (Cloud Consultation, CloudComm, ePalm) to enhance operational efficiency and healthcare service quality in primary care settings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: YSB serves a broad customer base including pharmacies, primary healthcare institutions (such as private clinics, township health centers, village clinics), pharmaceutical companies, distributors, and vendors. Its downstream users number over 820,000, with a significant presence in chain pharmacies and primary healthcare institutions across China. The company also targets pharmaceutical manufacturers for strategic partnerships and product launches.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates principally in the People's Republic of China, covering 98.9% of counties and 91.2% of towns nationwide. Its headquarters and major operations are based in Guangzhou, China, with a principal place of business in Hong Kong. All revenue and non-current assets are derived from and located in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: YSB operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It connects upstream pharmaceutical manufacturers and distributors with downstream pharmacies and healthcare institutions via its digital platform and self-operated sales channels. The company also engages in supply chain financial services and logistics management, enhancing efficiency and reducing costs across the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes digital transformation and AI integration to empower the pharmaceutical industry chain, focusing on enhancing user experience, operational efficiency, and product quality. R&D efforts include developing advanced point-of-care testing devices, AI diagnostic aids, and SaaS solutions tailored for pharmacies and primary healthcare institutions. Strategic acquisitions, such as Yikuai Pharmaceutical, support upstream integration and expansion of proprietary brands.
categories.revenue_model: YSB generates revenue mainly through product sales in its Self-operation Business and commission fees from third-party sellers on its Online Marketplace, with commission rates around 3.3%. Additional revenue streams include SaaS service fees for inventory and clinic management solutions, medical testing services, and training programs. The company also benefits from supply chain financial services by facilitating order financing for downstream buyers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: YSB positions itself as a leading digital service platform in China's outside-of-hospital pharmaceutical industry, leveraging its omni-channel strategy and extensive user base. It competes with other B2B pharmaceutical sales platforms and traditional pharmaceutical distributors. The company emphasizes its technological innovation, comprehensive service ecosystem, and strategic partnerships to maintain a competitive edge and consolidate market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, YSB reported revenue of RMB 17.9 billion, a 5.5% increase from the previous year, with steady growth driven mainly by the Self-operation Business. The company achieved profitability for the first time with a net profit of RMB 15.1 million, improving from a loss in 2023. It has over 6,700 employees and maintains a strong liquidity position with cash and cash equivalents exceeding RMB 1 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: YSB emphasizes providing accessible, convenient, and efficient pharmaceutical and healthcare services through digital innovation. Its value proposition includes a broad and diverse product offering, stringent quality control (e.g., Jinfang standards for TCM decoction pieces), rapid delivery capabilities (half-day delivery for many orders), and comprehensive digital tools that enhance operational efficiency for both upstream and downstream users. Proprietary brands and exclusive partnerships further differentiate its product portfolio.
